protocol: research_v3 us_long: out-of-period test of the frozen CAP_DEF_M rule on US data 1973-2005 using index/rate proxies
purpose: Validation, not optimisation. The rule is applied unchanged to a period never used in this project (high inflation 1970s, 1987 crash, 2000-02 bear). Results are recorded whatever they are.
prior_knowledge_disclosure: Published research (e.g. 10-month SMA timing and relative momentum studies starting in 1973) has documented trend-following behaviour in this period in general terms; no result of this specific rule on this period has been computed or viewed in this project.
rule_unchanged: Frozen CAP_DEF_M as in research_v3/candidates_frozen.json: weekly-anchored 12-month momentum (research_v2 compute_weekly_momentum), 40-week trend SMA (compute_weekly_trend), matched-monthly schedule, top 3, at most one asset per group, DEF slots (IEF proxy vs cash by 3-month return vs cash return), cost 5 bp + slippage 5 bp per side.

US_EQ.SPY_proxy: US total market daily total return: Kenneth French data library, daily Fama/French 3 factors, Mkt-RF + RF (CRSP value-weighted)
US_EQ.IWM_proxy: US small caps daily total return: Kenneth French 'Portfolios Formed on Size' daily, value-weighted bottom 30% (Lo 30)
US_EQ.QQQ_proxy: Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC, yfinance) daily price return; price-only (no dividends), declared deviation

INTL_EQ.EFA_proxy: Kenneth French 'Developed ex US 3 Factors' daily, Mkt-RF + RF; available from 1990-07 only
INTL_EQ.EEM_proxy: Kenneth French 'Emerging Markets 3 Factors' daily if available for the period, else unavailable
INTL_EQ.note: Before an asset's first date it is simply not in the universe (no backfill).

GOLD.GLD_proxy: London gold price daily in USD (FRED or LBMA via any public source); first source that covers 1971 onward, recorded

BONDS.IEF_proxy: synthetic 10-year constant-maturity par bond daily total return from FRED DGS10
BONDS.TLT_proxy: synthetic 30-year constant-maturity par bond daily total return from FRED DGS30 (available from 1977-02; before that not in the universe)
BONDS.synthetic_formula: r_t = y_{t-1}/252 + price change of a par bond with coupon y_{t-1} and maturity M repriced at y_t (exact bond pricing, semi-annual coupons); no roll-down

universe_proxies.cash: FRED DTB3 3-month T-bill (discount basis converted to bond-equivalent yield as in research_v3 cash_yield), previous-session rate, accrued per calendar day
universe_proxies.group_mapping: Groups and universe order as in the US frozen rule: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, GLD, TLT, IEF proxies in that order.

price_construction: Each proxy is turned into a total-return index (base 100). Signals and returns use that index. Proxies have closes only: signals at close t, trades executed at close t+1 (one-session lag instead of next open), declared deviation.
calendar: Sessions = dates on which the SPY proxy has a return; other proxies aligned to these dates, missing values forward-filled for valuation only (no new observation for signals); every fill is counted and reported.

sample.data_start: 1971-01-01 (or first available date of the SPY proxy and gold proxy, whichever is later)
sample.score_start: first monthly execution with all then-available assets warmed up (12-month momentum and 40-week trend computable), expected 1972-1973

benchmarks.US_60_40: 60% SPY proxy / 40% IEF proxy, rebalanced on the same monthly execution sessions
benchmarks.SPY_SMA10: SPY proxy if its month-end level is above its 10-month SMA of month-end levels, else cash (as in research_v3 step 4)

metrics: stationary block bootstrap (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019) 90% CI of excess Sharpe difference vs US_60_40 and vs SPY_BH
count of forward-filled values per proxy

SUPPORTED_if_all: FULL max drawdown < SPY_BH max drawdown
SUB_A and SUB_B excess Sharpe > US_60_40 (point estimates)
success_criteria.PARTIAL: drawdown criterion met but at least one Sharpe criterion failed, or vice versa
success_criteria.NOT_SUPPORTED: neither the drawdown criterion nor the FULL Sharpe criterion met
success_criteria.statistical_note: Bootstrap CI reported; a CI including 0 is described as not statistically distinguishable.

also_report_unchanged_reference: research_v3 BASE monthly T40 (v2 rule without CAP/DEF) on the same proxies, for context only.
reserved_for_later_challengers: This dataset may later serve as the evaluation set for pre-registered challengers (e.g. a crash overlay). Any challenger must be registered before its run; the frozen-rule results from this protocol will be visible by then and must be disclosed as such.
freeze_rule: Frozen at commit time; changes only via separately labelled amendments written before the affected run.
